member.name: T:Csv2Xml.Runtime.Writing.XmlTransformer
member.summary:
Streams CSV rows into XML via XmlWriter; memory is independent of input size (one row + open-element key stack). Rows sharing the same key at an outer repeating level (and contiguous in the input) collapse into one instance. Owned (non-repeating) content of an instance is emitted when the instance opens, i.e. before any repeating child. The same holds for a single element between levels (e.g. P holding F, T and repeating S): it is written once, its own values first, then the repeating children inside it.
Row checks (an error halts or skips the row per ErrorPolicy): field count must equal the header's; required values present; mapped values contain only XML-legal characters. Malformed CSV (unterminated quote) or undecodable bytes halt the run. Mapping problems (layout, unbound required targets, missing run values) throw MappingException before any output.
